## Documentation

A feature is not done until it is documented. Tick what applies, or say why it doesn't.

- [ ] README: the overview mentions it, with a link to its docs page
- [ ] Docs: a page or section in `docs/site` says what it does, who can use it (host, viewer, web viewer) and how, with shortcuts and settings, and is in the sidebar (`docs/site/sidebar.mjs`)
- [ ] Video: added or updated in `docs/video`, embedded on its docs page and listed in the README's Videos table, or no video needed because: …
- [ ] `just docs-build` passes
- [ ] Not user-facing (internal, CI, refactor), so none of the above: …
